system.description:
Trigger: You make an FBA attack or use a Combo Skill.

Lariat | Trigger — Light FBA/Combo: Your target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure they become [Stunned], [Staggered] and become grappled by you.

DDT | Trigger — Heavy FBA/Combo: Your target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure they begin [Suffocating] are [Grappled] by you. For every Phase that starts and ends with you grappling the target, the [Suffocation] gains 1 stage.

Full-Soul Suplex | Trigger — Grab FBA/Combo: You deal damage equal to [2 x Soul]. Your target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure they become [Dropped] and suffer a severe internal injury, losing one maximum Stamina until the end of this engagement. If you were grappling the target before using this Finisher, the target remains grappled by you.
